def in_pn_gtis(mjd_arr, pn_gtis):

def compute_exact_parker_ode(r_grid, gamma=1.5):
    """Integrate the exact 1D steady spherical Parker/Weber-Davis ODE from r_in=0.10 AU to 2.40 AU."""
    CODE_V0_KMS = 100.0
    CODE_B0_NT = 45.8506
    CODE_T_SCALE_K = 6.0554e5
    GM_SUN_CODE = 0.088713
    OMEGA_SUN_CODE = 0.042914

    r_in = 0.10
    rho0 = 700.0
    vr0 = 400.0 / CODE_V0_KMS
    br0 = 300.0 / CODE_B0_NT
    T0 = 5.0e5 / CODE_T_SCALE_K
    p0 = rho0 * T0

    mflux = r_in * r_in * rho0 * vr0
    bflux = r_in * r_in * br0
    K_ent = p0 / (rho0 ** gamma)

    def rhs(r, y):
        vr = y[0]
        rho = mflux / (r * r * vr)
        p = K_ent * (rho ** gamma)
        cs2 = gamma * p / rho
        bph = -bflux * OMEGA_SUN_CODE / (r * vr)
        ca_ph2 = (bph * bph) / rho
        num = 2.0 * cs2 / r + ca_ph2 / r - GM_SUN_CODE / (r * r)
        den = vr - (cs2 + ca_ph2) / vr
        return [num / den]

    sol = solve_ivp(rhs, [r_in, r_grid[-1]], [vr0], t_eval=r_grid, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-11)
    vr = sol.y[0]
    rho = mflux / (r_grid * r_grid * vr)
    p = K_ent * (rho ** gamma)
    T_K = (p / rho) * CODE_T_SCALE_K
    br_nT = (bflux / (r_grid * r_grid)) * CODE_B0_NT
    bph_nT = -(bflux * OMEGA_SUN_CODE / (r_grid * vr)) * CODE_B0_NT
    return {
        "r_au": r_grid,
        "n_cm3": rho,
        "vr_kms": vr * CODE_V0_KMS,
        "Br_nT": br_nT,
        "Bph_nT": bph_nT,
        "T_K": T_K,
    }

def load_native_spacecraft():
    """Load native 1 AU spacecraft observations (STEREO-A, Wind, Solar Orbiter)."""
    out = {}
    for key, fname in [
        ("stereo_a", "plasma_stereo_a.tsv"),
        ("wind", "plasma_wind.tsv"),
        ("solar_orbiter", "plasma_solar_orbiter.tsv"),
        ("ace", "plasma_ace.tsv"),
    ]:
        df = pd.read_csv(SC_DIR / fname, sep="\t")
        df["mjd"] = df["mjd_utc"].astype(float)
        df["proton_density_cm3"] = pd.to_numeric(df["density_cm3"], errors="coerce")
        df["proton_speed_kms"] = pd.to_numeric(df["speed_km_s"], errors="coerce")
        df = df[(df["proton_density_cm3"] > 0) & (df["proton_speed_kms"] > 150) & (df["proton_speed_kms"] < 1500)].copy()
        df["flux"] = df["proton_density_cm3"] * df["proton_speed_kms"] * 1e5
        out[key] = df.reset_index(drop=True)
    return out


def compute_1au_validation_and_plot(sc_obs):
    """Compare Argon 3D MHD Models 1, 2, 3, and Holdout against native 1 AU spacecraft observations."""
    m1 = pd.read_csv(RUNS_DIR / "model1_ccmc_probes.tsv", sep="\t")
    m2 = pd.read_csv(RUNS_DIR / "model2_wsa_cal_probes.tsv", sep="\t")
    m3 = pd.read_csv(RUNS_DIR / "model3_assimilated_probes.tsv", sep="\t")
    mh = pd.read_csv(RUNS_DIR / "model3_holdout_wind_probes.tsv", sep="\t")
    ccmc = np.load(PROC_DIR / "ccmc_extracted.npz")

    val_metrics = {}
    sc_list = [
        ("stereo_a", "STEREO-A (r=0.967 AU, lat=-5.36 deg)", "sta"),
        ("wind", "Wind / Earth L1 (r=0.986 AU, lat=+0.51 deg, Out-of-Sample Holdout Target)", "earth"),
        ("solar_orbiter", "Solar Orbiter (r=0.897 AU, lat=+9.44 deg)", None),
    ]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(15.5, 10.5), sharex=True)

    for row_idx, (sc_key, sc_title, ccmc_key) in enumerate(sc_list):
        obs = sc_obs[sc_key]
        obs_win = obs[(obs["mjd"] >= 61005.0) & (obs["mjd"] <= 61014.5)].copy()

        p1 = m1[m1["probe"] == sc_key]
        p2 = m2[m2["probe"] == sc_key]
        p3 = m3[m3["probe"] == sc_key]
        ph = mh[mh["probe"] == sc_key]

        mjd_grid = p3[(p3["mjd_utc"] >= 61005.0) & (p3["mjd_utc"] <= 61014.0)]["mjd_utc"].values
        obs_v = np.interp(mjd_grid, obs_win["mjd"].values, obs_win["proton_speed_kms"].values)
        obs_f = np.interp(mjd_grid, obs_win["mjd"].values, obs_win["flux"].values)
        obs_n = np.interp(mjd_grid, obs_win["mjd"].values, obs_win["proton_density_cm3"].values)

        val_metrics[sc_key] = {}
        for mod_name, df_mod in [
            ("model1_ccmc", p1),
            ("model2_wsa_cal", p2),
            ("model3_assimilated", p3),
            ("model3_holdout_wind", ph),
        ]:
            sub = df_mod[(df_mod["mjd_utc"] >= 61005.0) & (df_mod["mjd_utc"] <= 61014.0)]
            mod_v = sub["vmag_kms"].values
            mod_f = sub["flux_helio_cm2s"].values
            mod_n = sub["n_cm3"].values
            val_metrics[sc_key][mod_name] = {
                "speed_rmse_kms": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((mod_v - obs_v) ** 2))),
                "speed_mae_kms": float(np.mean(np.abs(mod_v - obs_v))),
                "speed_corr_r": float(pearsonr(mod_v, obs_v)[0]),
                "flux_median_ratio_mod_over_obs": float(np.median(mod_f / obs_f)),
                "flux_rmse_1e8": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(((mod_f - obs_f) / 1e8) ** 2))),
                "flux_corr_r": float(pearsonr(mod_f, obs_f)[0]),
                "density_median_ratio_mod_over_obs": float(np.median(mod_n / obs_n)),
            }

        ax_v = axes[row_idx, 0]
        ax_f = axes[row_idx, 1]

        t_obs = Time(obs_win["mjd"].values, format="mjd", scale="utc").to_datetime()
        t_mod = Time(p3["mjd_utc"].values, format="mjd", scale="utc").to_datetime()

        ax_v.scatter(t_obs, obs_win["proton_speed_kms"], s=8, color="#888888", alpha=0.55, label="In-Situ Obs")
        ax_v.plot(t_mod, p1["vmag_kms"], color="#7570b3", lw=1.2, ls=":", label="Model 1 (Uncal WSA/CCMC)")
        ax_v.plot(t_mod, p2["vmag_kms"], color="#1b9e77", lw=1.3, ls="--", label="Model 2 (Calibrated WSA)")
        ax_v.plot(t_mod, p3["vmag_kms"], color="#d95f02", lw=1.7, label="Model 3 (Assimilated 3D MHD)")
        if sc_key == "wind":
            ax_v.plot(t_mod, ph["vmag_kms"], color="#e7298a", lw=1.5, ls="-.", label="Holdout (Trained on STA+SolO only)")
        if ccmc_key is not None:
            t_cc = Time(ccmc[f"{ccmc_key}_mjd"], format="mjd", scale="utc").to_datetime()
            ax_v.plot(t_cc, ccmc[f"{ccmc_key}_vmag_cme"], color="#111111", lw=1.2, alpha=0.75, label="CCMC ENLIL v2.8f")

        ax_v.set_title(f"{sc_title} — Solar Wind Speed |V|")
        ax_v.set_ylabel("Speed [km/s]")
        ax_v.set_ylim(250, 780)
        ax_v.legend(loc="upper right", ncol=2, fontsize=7.5)

        ax_f.scatter(t_obs, obs_win["flux"] / 1e8, s=8, color="#888888", alpha=0.55, label="In-Situ Obs")
        ax_f.plot(t_mod, p1["flux_helio_cm2s"] / 1e8, color="#7570b3", lw=1.2, ls=":", label="Model 1 (Uncal CCMC-scale)")
        ax_f.plot(t_mod, p2["flux_helio_cm2s"] / 1e8, color="#1b9e77", lw=1.3, ls="--", label="Model 2 (Calibrated WSA)")
        ax_f.plot(t_mod, p3["flux_helio_cm2s"] / 1e8, color="#d95f02", lw=1.7, label="Model 3 (Assimilated 3D MHD)")
        if sc_key == "wind":
            ax_f.plot(t_mod, ph["flux_helio_cm2s"] / 1e8, color="#e7298a", lw=1.5, ls="-.", label="Holdout (Trained on STA+SolO only)")
        if ccmc_key is not None:
            t_cc = Time(ccmc[f"{ccmc_key}_mjd"], format="mjd", scale="utc").to_datetime()
            ax_f.plot(t_cc, ccmc[f"{ccmc_key}_flux_cme"] / 1e8, color="#111111", lw=1.2, alpha=0.75, label="CCMC ENLIL v2.8f")

        m3_ratio = val_metrics[sc_key]["model3_assimilated"]["flux_median_ratio_mod_over_obs"]
        m1_ratio = val_metrics[sc_key]["model1_ccmc"]["flux_median_ratio_mod_over_obs"]
        ax_f.set_title(f"{sc_title} — Proton Flux (Mod3/Obs={m3_ratio:.2f}, Uncal/Obs={m1_ratio:.2f})")
        ax_f.set_ylabel(r"Proton Flux $[10^8\ \mathrm{cm^{-2}\,s^{-1}}]$")
        ax_f.set_ylim(0, 8.5)
        ax_f.legend(loc="upper right", ncol=2, fontsize=7.5)

    for ax in axes[2, :]:
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b %d"))
        ax.set_xlabel("Date in Nov–Dec 2025 [UTC]")
    axes[0, 0].set_xlim(Time(61004.0, format="mjd").to_datetime(), Time(61015.0, format="mjd").to_datetime())

    fig.suptitle("1 AU Multi-Spacecraft Validation: Native In-Situ Observations vs. CCMC ENLIL & Argon 3D MHD Models",
                 fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=0.99)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.97])
    fig.savefig(FIG_DIR / "fig_1au_spacecraft_validation.png", bbox_inches="tight")
